The '''Rombo language''', or '''''Kirombo''''', is a [[Bantu languages|Bantu]] language of [[Tanzania]] spoken by the [[Chaga people|Rombos]] in the area of the [[Kilimanjaro]] region. Rombo forms a [[dialect continuum]] with other [[Chaga languages]].

== Dialects ==
The dialects of Rombo are Useri (Kiseri), Mashati (Kimashati), Mkuu (Kimkuu), Mengwe (Kimengwe), and Kimahida; Kiseri is said to be the original form of the Rombo language.<ref name="Guthrie"/>
